question: A person observes an object on the ground from the top of a tower at an angle of depression 60°. If the distance between the foot of the tower and the object is 10sqrt{3} m, then find the height (in m) of the tower.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In a 30°-60°-90° right-angled triangle, the ratio of the sides opposite to the angles is 1 : √3 : 2.

The angle of elevation is equal to the angle of depression (60°).

The side opposite to 30° (base distance) is 10√3 m.

The side opposite to 60° (tower height) will be √3 times the base.

Height = 10√3 × √3 = 30 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 30 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 
 
• 
 60° 
 60° A B C h 10√3 m 

**Given:**

Angle of depression from the top of the tower = 60°

Distance of the object from the foot of the tower (BC) = 10√3 m

Let the height of the tower be 'h' meters.

**Formula Used:**

tan(θ) = Perpendicular ÷ Base

**Calculations:**

⇒ The horizontal line of sight is parallel to the ground.

⇒ Therefore, alternate interior angles are equal, making the angle of elevation (∠C) = 60°.

⇒ In right-angled ΔABC,

⇒ tan(60°) = AB ÷ BC

⇒ √3 = h ÷ 10√3

⇒ h = 10√3 × √3

⇒ h = 10 × 3

⇒ h = 30 m

**∴ The correct answer is 30 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Angle of Elevation and Depression

Angle of elevation is measured upwards from the horizontal line of sight, while angle of depression is measured downwards. They form a pair of alternate interior angles and are always equal in magnitude.

Important Trigonometric Ratios

For standard right triangles in height and distance problems, memorize: tan(30°) = 1/√3, tan(45°) = 1, and tan(60°) = √3.

30°-60°-90° Triangle Theorem

The sides opposite the angles of 30°, 60°, and 90° follow a fixed ratio of x : x√3 : 2x respectively. This helps solve geometry questions directly without using trigonometric formulas.
